meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用 Anthropic 官方品牌色（深色、浅色、中灰、浅灰及橙、蓝、绿强调色）和字体（标题用 Poppins，正文用 Lora）来美化你创建的文档或图表等制品。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 应用品牌颜色、字体或公司设计标准时触发，例如在制作演示文稿或视觉内容时。

say.text: 用 Anthropic 品牌风格美化这个幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会应用品牌色和字体到幻灯片内容。

say.text: 给这段文字加上 Anthropic 的配色和字体。
say.note: Claude 会调整文字颜色和字体为品牌规范。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will apply Anthropic's official brand colors (dark, light, mid gray, light gray, and orange/blue/green accents) and typography (Poppins for headings, Lora for body) to artifacts like documents or charts you create.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to apply brand colors, fonts, or company design standards, such as when creating presentations or visual content.

say_en.text: Style this slide with Anthropic's brand guidelines.
say_en.note: Claude applies brand colors and fonts to the slide.

say_en.text: Apply Anthropic's color palette and fonts to this text.
say_en.note: Claude adjusts text colors and fonts per brand specs.
